root_cause.text: A refactoring of the S390 hardware acceleration buffer preparation code removed the folio_put() call that releases the reference to folios obtained from btrfs_compress_filemap_get_folio(), causing a memory leak in the copy_data_into_buffer() function.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a single line `folio_put(folio);` after `kunmap_local(data_in);` in the copy_data_into_buffer() function. The commit message explicitly states that the previous code called `folio_put()` after handling each folio, but the refactored code (commit aa60fe12b4f4) "lacks the call to release the filemap folio," resulting in unreleased folio references that accumulate as memory leaks on S390 systems.
